bites.title: The tabs up top
bites.body: See the tabs along the very top of the window (Layout, Modeling, Sculpting, Shading...)? Each is a workspace: the same scene, arranged for a different job. You're in one called Blender Bites right now.

bites.title: Visit Shading
bites.body: Click the Shading tab. Material preview, a node editor, an image browser, all laid out for painting with light.
bites.hint: Top bar of the window, the tab named Shading.

bites.title: Visit Modeling
bites.body: Now click the Modeling tab. A big viewport, tools on the left, ready for edit mode.

bites.title: Come home
bites.body: Click the Blender Bites tab to come back here.
bites.hint: The Blender Bites tab is with the others along the top. Scroll the tab row if it's hidden.

bites.title: Save your work
bites.body: Press Ctrl+S. If this file has never been saved, Blender asks where. Call it my_first_scene.blend.
bites.hint: Ctrl+S, pick a folder, type a name, click Save.

bites.title: F1, forever
bites.body: F1 keeps working after you graduate. Hover anything strange and ask. Right-click any button for EXPLAIN, too.

bites.title: You graduated
bites.body:
Viewport, seeing, making, organizing, properties, edit mode, modeling, modifiers, materials, nodes, light, camera, render, animation, workspaces. That's Blender.

Scroll down and the whole program is yours. Go make something weird.
